title: Choose a Boot Slot (A/B Update with Anti-Rollback)
statement:
A device keeps two firmware slots, **A** and **B**. An update is written to the inactive slot. The bootloader then has to decide which slot to start. Write that decision.

## The slot header

```
struct slot_header {
    int      valid;             /* image signature and hash verified */
    uint32_t version;           /* the release number */
    uint32_t security_version;  /* the anti-rollback number */
    uint32_t trial_remaining;   /* boots left for an unconfirmed image */
    int      confirmed;         /* the image has proved it works */
};
```

## The rules

A slot is **bootable** only if **all** of these hold:

- `valid` is non-zero.
- `security_version >= min_security_version`. This is the anti-rollback floor, held in fuses.
- It is `confirmed`, **or** it still has `trial_remaining > 0` boots left.

Then choose:

- If both are bootable, take the one with the **higher `version`**. On a tie, take **A**.
- If only one is bootable, take it.
- If neither is, report that.

## Your function

```
int select_slot(const struct slot_header *a, const struct slot_header *b,
                uint32_t min_security_version);
```

Return `0` for A, `1` for B, `-1` if neither can boot.

The harness reads, on each line, the five fields of A, the five fields of B, then `min_security_version`.

## Watch out

- A newer image that has used up its trial boots without ever confirming is **not** bootable, however high its version. That is how a bad update rolls back.
- The anti-rollback floor applies to both slots, including a confirmed one.
- `version` and `security_version` are different numbers. Do not mix them up.

tests.name: new image on trial, boots left
tests.description: Unconfirmed but still on trial. Newest wins.

tests.name: new image used its trial boots
tests.description: Never confirmed, no boots left. Roll back to A.

tests.name: older image is below the anti-rollback floor
tests.description: Both have security_version 1, below the floor of 2. Neither boots.

tests.name: only the new image meets the floor
a high version number is not a high security version
A is invalid, B is the only choice
a confirmed slot with zero trial boots
tests.description: Confirmed means trial_remaining no longer matters.
